name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
💎 Whole-App Liquid Glassmorphism: Frosted acrylic translucent cards, specular glossy top highlights & glossy buttons across the entire app
✨ Cyber Aurora Prism: Futuristic holographic glass theme with iridescent chromatic edges, vibrant ambient glow & 3D tactile refraction
🎨 3-Tier Visual Style System: Seamlessly toggle between Pure AMOLED, Liquid Glass, or Cyber Aurora while keeping all color themes intact
🚀 Direct In-App APK Updater: Centered glassmorphic dialogs, live progress tracking & 1-tap package installation
📱 Universal Display Layout: 100% responsive across all phone display sizes with zero text clipping
💡 Mobile Cookie Guide & 1-Tap Auto-Adjuster for Android phones
